678-4022-6495.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-6495.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat.
678-4022-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

333-5686-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5686-8207.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

891-2438-8207.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

728-2281-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

628-3899-7865.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

4871-5113-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5113-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-7818.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5016-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Spitemare to take damage.
5016-5166--86.description:
Cause Spitemare to take damage by any method.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Spitemare.
Repeat from step 2.

803-3490-5231-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
803-3490-5231-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Arcane Adaptation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-5434-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5434-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Yarus so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

240-643-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-2921.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

413-1628-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
413-1628-3490-7426.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Berta triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat

3967-4986-5915--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel
Repeat.
3967-4986-5915--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

3587-7264.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
3587-7264.description:
Cast Rush of Vitality by paying {1}{B}, targeting Boros Reckoner.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 any number of times.

315-1012-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-1269-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-6797.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-2265-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Hardened Scales.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

4067-4842-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-4842-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

658-3544-4050-5751-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
658-3544-4050-5751-6556.description:
Cast Auramancer from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {W} and discarding Urza's Saga.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Urza's Saga from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auramancer, adding {W}.
Repeat.

654-1445-2366-3809-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-3809-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-2523-5563.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Uruk-hai Berserker trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1339-3311-6096.notablePrerequisites:
Snake Umbra attached to General Kreat.
You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3311-6096.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering General Kreat, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2079-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1636-2857-3967.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1636-2857-3967.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

65-5671--48.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it, causing you to mill two cards and return the land from your graveyard to your hand due to the land's dredge ability.
Repeat.

3259-3973-4214-4478.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3973-4214-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-3185-4613.notablePrerequisites: Evernight Shade has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3185-4613.description:
Activate Evernight Shade using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Evernight Shade has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Evernight Shade abilities dealing 1 damage to Evernight Shade, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Evernight Shade dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Evernight Shade's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1355-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Sanctum Weaver.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
1355-3525.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat for infinite blue mana.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may activate Sanctum Weaver an infinitely large number of times, adding infinite colored mana.

467-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
467-2034-2178.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Thornbite Staff's equip ability by paying {4}, attaching it to Shorikai.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Shorikai triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1640-3799.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Stuffy Doll if it has summoning sickness.
1640-3799.description:
Deal damage to Stuffy Doll, either using its ability or another method.
Stuffy Doll triggers, attempting to deal damage to you, but dealing damage to Stuffy Doll instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-3756.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-1993-3756.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener
Repeat.
